t: In this Act, the term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Transportation.

fable.w: This section is purely a definition identifying "Secretary" as the Secretary of Transportation, a federal official. There is no tempting reading here: it creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.
fable.s: In this Act, the term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Transportation.

opus.w: This section only defines 'Secretary' as the Secretary of Transportation. It sets up no process involving anyone outside the federal government, such as a consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue. Naming a federal official is not participation, because that official is inside the federal government.
